request: Retry guarded AI Core physical 4-private-backend migration after prior failed before effects; retrieve existing API key only within running Gate, no credential echo

bounded_host_request.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
root=/home/admin1/projects/ai-core
w="$root/.worktrees/pr3-verification-20261015"
backup="$root/.ai-core/uds-cutover-75778b66"
target=75778b66afcd397da5225466aadcc20fcd0df991
expected=5f52b6c26ba70a7eb1c6e7fc5af93980708ca3208fb41b72ef307797162d9432
models=(granite qwen3 ministral coder)
new=(docker compose -p ai-core --project-directory "$root" -f "$w/compose.runtime.yml")
old=(docker compose -p ai-core --project-directory "$root" -f "$root/compose.runtime.yml" -f "$backup/old-cgroup.yml")
gate=(docker compose -p ai-core-gate --project-directory "$w" -f "$w/compose.gate.yml")
mutated=0
rollback() {
 set +e
 echo ROLLBACK_BEGIN
 "${gate[@]}" stop gate >/dev/null 2>&1
 "${old[@]}" up --no-start --force-recreate --no-deps "${models[@]}" >/dev/null 2>&1
 backends_rc=$?
 docker tag ai-core-model-gate:rollback-75778b66 ai-core-model-gate:local
 image_rc=$?
 "${gate[@]}" up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate gate >/dev/null 2>&1
 gate_rc=$?
 echo "ROLLBACK_RESULT backend=$backends_rc image=$image_rc gate=$gate_rc"
 gh api -X POST repos/G-ACE-inc/server-core/issues/10/comments -f "body=AI_CORE_UDS_CUTOVER_ROLLBACK backend=$backends_rc image=$image_rc gate=$gate_rc" --jq .html_url || true
}
trap 'rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] && [ "$mutated" -eq 1 ]; then rollback; fi; exit "$rc"' EXIT
test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$target"
test -z "$(git -C "$w" status --porcelain)"
test -f "$backup/old-cgroup.yml"
docker image inspect ai-core-model-gate:uds-stage-75778b66 >/dev/null
docker image inspect ai-core-model-gate:rollback-75778b66 >/dev/null
for name in "${models[@]}"; do
 test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "ai-$name")" = false
done
docker exec -i ai-core-model-gate python3 - <<'PY'
import os,json,urllib.request
headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+os.environ['AI_CORE_API_KEY']}
def get(path):
 q=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:18184'+path,headers=headers)
 with urllib.request.urlopen(q,timeout=6) as r:return json.load(r)
a=get('/internal/handoff/status');b=get('/internal/resources/status')
assert (not any(a['active'].values()) and a['handoff'] is None and
 not a['recovery_pending'] and not b['queued'] and
 not b['admission_inflight'] and not b['transitioning']),'GATE_BUSY'
print('QUIESCENCE=PASS')
PY
key="$(docker exec ai-core-model-gate python3 -c 'import os;print(os.environ["AI_CORE_API_KEY"],end="")')"
test -n "$key"
export AI_CORE_API_KEY="$key"
unset key
mutated=1
docker stop --time 30 ai-core-model-gate >/dev/null
for name in "${models[@]}"; do
 test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "ai-$name")" = false
done
"${new[@]}" up --no-start --force-recreate --no-deps "${models[@]}" >/dev/null
for name in "${models[@]}"; do
 test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "ai-$name")" = false
 test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.HostConfig.CgroupParent}}' "ai-$name")" = ai-core.slice
 test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name}}' "ai-$name")" = no
 docker inspect -f '{{json .HostConfig.PortBindings}}' "ai-$name" | grep -qv HostPort
 docker inspect -f '{{json .Mounts}}' "ai-$name" | grep -q ai-core-backend-bus
done
docker tag ai-core-model-gate:uds-stage-75778b66 ai-core-model-gate:local
"${gate[@]}" up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate gate >/dev/null
healthy=0
for attempt in $(seq 1 18); do
 if docker exec ai-core-model-gate python3 -c "import hashlib,urllib.request;from pathlib import Path;assert hashlib.sha256(Path('/app/runtime/model_gate.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='$expected';[urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:%d/health'%p,timeout=3).close() for p in (18181,18182,18183,18184)]" >/dev/null 2>&1; then healthy=1;break;fi
 sleep 2
done
test "$healthy" = 1
mutated=0
trap - EXIT
echo "AI_CORE_UDS_CUTOVER=PASS HEAD=$target HEALTH=4/4 RESIDENTS=0"
gh api -X POST repos/G-ACE-inc/server-core/issues/10/comments -f "body=AI_CORE_UDS_CUTOVER=PASS; head=$target; Gate source=$expected; private backend sockets=4; no published TCP ports; 4 Gate HTTP health PASS; rollback image retained. Inference not yet verified." --jq .html_url || true
